name: Appartement Seeberger
beschreibung: Appartement Seeberger in Strengen is a holiday apartment located in the Stanzer Tal valley. Set on the edge of the village, the property enjoys lovely views of the surrounding mountain scenery. The apartment features a kitchenette, a living area, a bedroom, and a separate bathroom. Depending on the unit, a private balcony or terrace is provided. Guests have access to a ski storage room and parking facilities. The location is ideal for summer hiking and serves as a convenient base for trips to the premier ski area of St. Anton am Arlberg. The nearest ski bus stop is within walking distance. The apartment is offered on a self-catering basis.
